name: Marcel Dettling
bio: Marcel Dettling (born 1 February 1981 in Einsiedeln) is a Swiss farmer and politician of the Swiss People's Party (SVP/UDC). He runs a mountain farm in Oberiberg, canton Schwyz, and has represented Schwyz in the National Council (Nationalrat) since 2015. A founding member of the Young SVP Schwyz in 1998, he served on the cantonal council of Schwyz from 2008 to 2016. He joined the SVP Switzerland party leadership committee in 2018, became vice-president of the party in 2022, and on 23 March 2024 was elected president of the SVP Switzerland, succeeding Marco Chiesa. He is associated with the party's conservative wing and is known for emphasising restrictions on immigration and opposition to closer ties with the European Union. He is married to Priska and has three children.
